title: Install the Apollo tray dependency on Debian 13
problem: The Thunderbolt installer requests gir1.2-appindicator3-0.1, which has no installation candidate on Debian 13, so dependency installation fails before an Apollo interface can be configured.
reproduce: Run check_install_deps from the current installer in a clean Debian 13 container. Apt rejects gir1.2-appindicator3-0.1 with 'no installation candidate' and the dependency step returns 1.
acceptance: Apt-based installs request gir1.2-ayatanaappindicator3-0.1, the dependency step completes on Debian 13, older supported apt releases retain an available package, and the selection has an executable regression test.
repair: Use the maintained Ayatana AppIndicator GIR package for apt distributions and add the dependency selector to the installer unit-test job.

verification.limitations: BCL proves the dependency selector and a Debian 13 container proves the apt transaction. No Apollo hardware is needed for this installer failure; audio playback and capture are outside this change.
verification.ownerCheck: On Debian 13, run sudo bash scripts/install.sh and confirm the dependency summary installs gir1.2-ayatanaappindicator3-0.1 without the former 'no installation candidate' error. Continue with the issue's playback and capture checklist on the connected Apollo.

selection.reason: An Apollo owner supplied the exact failing Debian package and a manual fix; there is no competing PR, and the failure is reproducible without access to the interface.

publish.commitMessage: fix: use Ayatana AppIndicator on apt distributions
